source.title: Ashenvale Mission XI: Fool's Gold Dust
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow and collect Fool's Gold Dust from within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of a miner.
source.objective: Gather 10 Fool's Gold Dust in the Ashenvale Nightmare Incursions and return to Field Captain Hannalah.
source.progress: You have the Fool's Gold Dust?
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
